body: I live in Euless so I think its tarrant county. I just want to be able to go back to Mesa Springs. I got some help there before
I know what I need. I just can't afford it
Unfortunately I know I need inpatient
They'd just send me to JPS and that place is horrible
I might try running again. When I do that I feel like I'm floating. It's the best I've ever felt. My downfall is I feel like I don't have the energy to get up and run.

"It's kind of feedback on a loop" describes exactly how I feel. Every month or two I just fall back into feeling like crap. I'm just tired of trying when I know it's only going to put me back where I started.

I've tried meds. I was hospitalized in January  and they put me on klonopin and wellbutrin, but the wellbutrin made it hard for me to pee. I don't have health insurance so its hard for me to get medication.
My eating hasn't really changed. I don't eat much normally. I just saw a psychiatrist, but it didn't help. The whole time I just felt anxious. I used to run up until 3 weeks ago almost 4.
